expected.title: Jef the Farm Boy Comes to Town

lines.text: Dockers, sailors and small fry! Hats off, noses up, the Poesje is on!
N-n-news, Neus? I heard some. I think.
Heard? I saw it with my own nose. Fact 0.
It wasn't like that at all! I only came to town for work!
Th-that's not how it went, Neus. It went w-worse.
The police? They're in the tavern with the rest of us!
Then g-g-give him the stick, Neus. Gently.
Gently it is. Knock! And good night to you all!
